supersedes: rev B co-mission and rev B D2/D3 deliverable definitions; completed P1/P2/P3/D4/D5 and Track C artifacts remain valid inputs
claim_under_test: On multi-turn agent workloads, a substantial fraction of total model-side cost (time, dollars, energy) is orchestration-induced redundant prefill; this fraction (a) grows with turn index, (b) is attributable per-call via the audited f(n) necessary/redundant split, and (c) is causally recoverable by orchestration-layer changes alone, at a measured software cost — yielding an orchestration exchange rate (ΔT_orch spent : model-side cost recovered) that quantifies the leverage of the orchestration layer in today's units.
pre_registered_null: Engine/provider default caching may already recover nearly everything, making Arm A approximately equal to Arm B. This banks rung_3c and is a publishable finding about ecosystem defaults.

rung_1c.meaning: orchestration is a first-order, causally demonstrated cost lever

rung_2c.meaning: leverage exists but is workload-shaped; report the taxonomy

rung_3c.meaning: the induced-cost thesis in its causal form does not hold as tested; bank honestly

locked_decisions.fanout_siblings: count of independent sibling tool calls after the same LLM decision; not separate steps
locked_decisions.retemplated_tokens: first_class_callrecord_field; LCP failures count as new tokens
locked_decisions.tool_replay_default: live_for_deterministic_local; archived_for_network_or_flaky; mode recorded per tool per swapped run
locked_decisions.prefill_intercept_booking: intercept_to_necessary_conservative_bias_against_thesis; any paired Arm A/Arm B delta survives this booking by construction

baseline_naive.label: Arm A
baseline_naive.prompt_layout: framework_default; dynamic-first only when traceable to a real default or documented production pattern
baseline_naive.honesty_rule: may_not_be_artificially_degraded; every behavior requires a citation in PROTOCOL_NOTES

interventions.B-CACHE: retain verified engine KV cache across turns and tool boundaries; on cloud infer provider reuse from cached_tokens
interventions.B-APPEND: immutable append-only context; prior bytes never mutated, reserialized, or reordered; retemplated_tokens must be zero after turn 0
interventions.B-LAYOUT: static system and tool definitions first; per-turn dynamic content appended last; no upstream timestamp or counter
interventions.B-SHAPE: cloud-only cache-aware request shaping with provider cached_tokens reconciled to structural LCP

Class_I.name: mechanism_proof
Class_I.pair_requirement: per-turn assembled context byte hashes identical across arms

Class_II.name: ecosystem_realistic
Class_II.pair_requirement: same class seed harness deployment and step sequence; parity gate

task_suite.design: scripted_with_real_payloads; fixed step sequence, deterministic seedable real tool outputs

prebox_feasibility.cpu_model_requirement: small CPU-viable instruct model, 1-1.5B class preferred, Q4 quant, context_length_ge_16384
prebox_feasibility.model_tuple_gate: full prefill/decode/cache calibration before suite; R2_ge_0_99 and domain coverage
prebox_feasibility.allowed_cut_order: reduce CPU-only context targets, then CPU-only seed count; record in PROTOCOL_NOTES
prebox_feasibility.box_context_grid: extend to 65536 where selected local model permits

G_PAIR.class_i: per-turn context byte hashes identical across arms; otherwise pair_context_divergence and exclude
G_PAIR.class_ii: identical class seed harness deployment and step sequence; Arm B retemplated_tokens=0 after turn0 or append_discipline_violated

G_PARITY.rule: task_success exact equality across paired deterministic temp0 trajectories
G_PARITY.failure: investigate, exclude pair, and record in boundary-cases.md

G_CACHE_TRUTH.rule: warm prefill approximately f(new_tokens) within profile consistency band per run batch

G_BUDGET_WALL.rule: CPU f(n) wall projection and refreshed cloud budget_lock must exist before launch

G_ARM_A_HONESTY.rule: every baseline behavior mapped to a cited real framework default or documented production pattern in PROTOCOL_NOTES

provider_cache_reconciliation.rule: structurally_redundant_tokens <= engine_tokens_in; actually_recomputed_tokens = max(0, structurally_redundant_tokens - provider_cached_tokens); flag provider_cache_reconciliation only when provider_cached_tokens > structurally_redundant_tokens + tolerance_envelope_tokens
provider_cache_reconciliation.rationale: Provider cache counters are block-quantized and provider-internal serialization differs from the local canonical prompt; this is the existing OA-01 reconciliation rule.

headline_derivations.aggregation: per class x deployment; min median max across seeds; harnesses reported separately and pooled only when compatible

deliverables.C-D1: recalibration report plus CPU wall-clock budget projection
deliverables.C-D2: per-task cards for each class x deployment with paired decomposition, cumulative redundant curves, ideal bound, exchange bands, and audit summary
deliverables.C-D3: headline exchange-rate table with recovered_fraction, ideal_bound_capture, ms/$/J currencies, Arm B overhead, and ablation attribution
deliverables.C-D4: cloud economics annex with three-way cache split, real dollars per task, and reconciliation stats
deliverables.C-D5: honest-scope and threats note plus banked rung

protocol_lock.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON parsed then serialized with sorted keys and compact separators; omit protocol_lock.sha256 before hashing
